description: Source code implementing generic reference iterator infrastructure for Git, including iterator management, merging, overlay, prefix filtering, and iteration functions.

classes.name: struct ref_iterator
classes.description: Generic reference iterator structure with vtable for operations.

classes.name: struct empty_ref_iterator
classes.description: A minimal implementation of a reference iterator that is always done.

classes.name: struct merge_ref_iterator
classes.description: An iterator that merges two reference iterators with custom selection logic.

classes.name: struct prefix_ref_iterator
classes.description: An iterator that filters references by a prefix, with optional trimming.

methods.name: ref_iterator_advance
methods.description: Advances the reference iterator to the next reference.

methods.name: ref_iterator_seek
methods.description: Seeks the reference iterator to a specific reference name.

methods.name: empty_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates a new empty reference iterator.

methods.name: is_empty_ref_iterator
methods.description: Checks if a reference iterator is the empty iterator.

methods.name: merge_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates a new merge reference iterator from two iterators with a selection function.

methods.name: overlay_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates an overlay iterator that combines two iterators, prioritizing the front.

methods.name: prefix_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates a prefix-filtered reference iterator with optional trimming.

methods.name: do_for_each_ref_iterator
methods.description: Iterates over all references in an iterator, applying a callback function.
